app.name: thoughtspot_mongodb_voyage_pov_frontend
app.routeModel: tenant-scoped SPA with nested workspace routes
constraints: Do not assume binary file upload/download; document registration is metadata/sourceUri based only.
Do not assume server-side query embedding generation; endpoints that require queryEmbedding must obtain it from an external app service or manual input outside this API contract.
Do not expose update/delete actions for documents, chunks, ground truth sets, or benchmark runs because the API contract does not provide them.
Do not assume a document detail endpoint exists; document-specific screens should derive context from list endpoints, search results, and document-scoped chunk/chunking endpoints.

loading_patterns: Skeletons or spinners for full-page loads
Polling indicators for processing and benchmark status screens
error_patterns: Full-page not found states for tenant-scoped 404s
Conflict resolution panel for duplicate document 409
Retryable banner/toast for transient network/server failures
empty_patterns: No benchmark runs or no completed comparable runs
polling_patterns: DocumentProcessingMonitor polls getDocumentProcessingStatus on interval until user stops or all selected documents are terminal
BenchmarkRunsList polls listBenchmarkRuns to refresh running/completed/failed statuses after new runs are created

known_gaps_due_to_api_contract: No binary file upload transport; frontend can only register metadata/sourceUri for documents.
No API to generate query embeddings server-side; search screens requiring queryEmbedding must rely on an external embedding provider or manual/test input.
No document update/delete APIs; document management UI is create/list/inspect only.
No ground truth set listing endpoint; users can create a set and load by known name, but cannot browse all sets unless the app separately tracks names client-side.
No benchmark run detail endpoint beyond question analysis/list/compare; detailed run metadata must come from list responses and route context.
No endpoint for direct chunk creation/materialization or ingestion orchestration details; frontend can only reflect persisted status and debug/query outcomes.
No document detail-by-id endpoint; screens needing document context must use route params plus list/search responses.
